title: GitHub App installation token beside a note that it lasts one hour
summary: A GitHub App installation token in a CI log line next to the sentence that the token expires after one hour. Shape only; the fixture value is not recorded in this record.
rationale: The provider documents a one-hour lifetime. Short life makes a token less useful to an attacker but does not make it benign while the hour runs, and a log excerpt carries no clock. The case keeps the lifetime note from turning into a suppression rule by accident. The token format itself changed in a staged rollout the provider announced for 2026-04-27; format questions belong to the separate GitHub installation token format review and are not decided here.

expectation.rationale: No outcome asserted. Provider-documented: the installation access token expires after 1 hour. Not documented: treatment of an expired-looking or short-lived token in text. Recommendation, not a decision: expect it to be reported while its age is unknown. Would settle it: a recorded project-policy decision with a non-author reviewer.

sources.supports: The installation access token will expire after 1 hour.
